frozen: 2026-11-01, plan v5 step 4b (Gate 0 G0.3 Bucket / Land types / Alfalfa / Water chain; Gate 1 G1.1-G1.7); change only as a new version
purpose: Daily soil-water balance per parcel summed into calendar dekads: NET demand (mm, m3) expected at plan time and actual for the ledger. Field efficiency (gross) is applied once, in wp_core/canal_allocation.py.

no_hindsight.s2_rule: a scene dated t is usable from t + 1 day
no_hindsight.weather_rule: ERA5 complete to as_of - 6 days; days as_of-5 .. dekad start-1 and the planned dekad use 1991-2020 normals, tagged 'expected'
no_hindsight.actual_rule: actual dekad values (ERA5 + daily Kc) reach the ledger only after dekad end + 10 days

cloud_leak.detector: causal, per scene date: among parcels with a previous unmasked clear view within max_gap_days whose previous NDVI >= veg_ndvi, the share whose NDVI fell by >= dip_ndvi on this date; a date is a candidate when that share >= min_share over >= min_parcels parcels. Uses only views up to the date itself (later recovery is never evidence). Masked dates are not used as 'previous' views.
cloud_leak.calibration: 2023 and 2025 per-date stats: ordinary dates 1-6 % of vegetated parcels dip >= 0.10, partial/hazy scenes 20-80 %

land_classes.source: land types v1.4 (frozen static map made in late 2026: stated hindsight leak; the same map is used for every year)

CROPLAND_UNCERTAIN.note: Field land, 2025 use not specified (group K)

NOT_CLASSIFIABLE.note: v1.4 'not classifiable' (fixed NCI: under 0.01 ha or under 5 m mean width); slivers, no demand

winter.rule: Nov-Jan daily balance with actual ERA5 and no irrigation gives the 1 Feb depletion (not full)

bucket.reference: full-supply reference bucket: every dekad receives its planned full-basis net demand spread evenly over its days; the core drives its own bucket with the simulated allocation via bucket_step

demand.full: max(0, depletion at dekad start + ETc - effective rain - RAW at dekad end)
demand.typical: max(0, depletion at dekad start + f * ETc - effective rain - RAW at dekad end)
demand.charging: refill below RAW (max(0, Dr + ETc - rain_eff) - full): spring/autumn charging, surplus-only, never in net demand
demand.kc_plan: daily Kc at as_of (latest usable clear view) held for the bridging days and the planned dekad

tags.observed: fresh clear view on a wide parcel or with valid inner pixels
tags.type-based: fresh view but a strip under 20 m without valid inner pixels: type calendar (perennials) or community median of wide fresh FIELD_CROP parcels (field land)
tags.fallback: no fresh view: same estimate, separate tag (G1.5)

presowing.window: from the earliest earlier-year sowing estimate - 14 days to the latest earlier-year sowing estimate (day of year), parcel's own earlier years only
presowing.applies_to: field land (crop or typical_only rule), not alfalfa; land cropped the previous year; stops once this year's green-up is seen as of as_of

alfalfa_after_cut.rule: only after a cut confirmed by two consecutive clear views (add_causal is_drop) usable by as_of: full net demand >= 0.5 x ETc

ripening.rule: field land (not alfalfa), observed view at as_of below 0.85 x season peak so far, at least 10 days after the peak; helper for the core's floors

capacity_reference.statistic: P90 of dekad net demand 2021-2024 (actual), per parcel group; branch P90 is taken by the core from the per-parcel dekad table
